# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island (over-harbour)  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

Ambrose is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome middle-aged man with Roman features and clear gray eyes [v04:c09:p0013]. For fifteen years, he maintained a massive, wavy, knee-length brown beard and long rippling hair down his back [v04:c09:p0013, v04:c09:p0018]. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he revealed a smooth-shaven, firm chin [v04:c09:p0000, v04:c09:p0035].

_Sources: [v4 c9 P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P18](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0018), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a cheerful, sharp, well-read, and witty man who possesses a natural talent for storytelling and a great sense of humor [v04:c09:p0014, v04:c09:p0028, v04:c09:p0065]. He is fiercely principled, stubborn, and stubbornly independent, maintaining a political vow for fifteen years despite the mockery of others [v04:c09:p0018, v04:c09:p0023]. In his youth, he was a famous dancer, and he retains an energetic and spirited nature into middle age [v04:c09:p0011, v04:c09:p0028].

_Sources: [v4 c9 P11](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0011), [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c9 P18](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0018), [v4 c9 P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028)_

- Sharp and well-read  <sub>[v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>
- Great storyteller  <sub>[v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>

- Talented dancer  <sub>[v4 c9 P11](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing Scotch ballads  <sub>[v4 c9 P11](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0011)</sub>
- Dancing  <sub>[v4 c9 P11](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0011), [v4 c9 P12](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0012)</sub>
- Storytelling  <sub>[v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014)</sub>

## Goals

- Support the Liberal party and see them win an election  <sub>[v4 c9 P18](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0018), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>
- Marry Miss Winifred Tolley  <sub>[v4 c9 P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028)</sub>

## History

During an election fifteen years prior, Ambrose Kerr, a passionate Liberal, publicly swore not to shave his beard or trim his hair until his party achieved a political victory [v04:c09:p0018]. He kept this vow faithfully, growing an extraordinarily long beard and hair that made him a well-known local oddity [v04:c09:p0013, v04:c09:p0023]. During a stormy November evening, he met Nell Harcourt on the road after agreeing to a political deal with Tobias Corcoran, though he later assured Nell he would vote according to his principles [v04:c09:p0061, v04:c09:p0071]. When the Liberals finally won a landslide election, Ambrose immediately went to the local barber in the middle of the night to be shaved and groomed [v04:c09:p0035]. Shortly afterward, he renewed his long-standing courtship of Miss Winifred Tolley, and the two agreed to marry [v04:c09:p0025, v04:c09:p0028].

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P18](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0018), [v4 c9 P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 c9 P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 c9 P28](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0028), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c9 P61](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0061)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the Kerr family over the harbour  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>
- Was a famous dancer in his youth  <sub>[v4 c9 P11](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0011)</sub>
- Made a public vow during a fierce election fifteen years prior to refrain from shaving or cutting his hair until the Liberals won power  <sub>[v4 c9 P18](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0018)</sub>

## Quotes

> The Liberals have won, and you will be haircutting a fine Grit prior to sunrise.  <sub>[v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035)</sub>

> I’m a crabbed, lonesome, crusty old chap, but I feel young again because of something about that little girl . . . and having that sensation repeated once in a while is something I’d like, since it’s so pleasant.  <sub>[v4 c3 P49](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0049)</sub>
